variants.name: Current architecture
variants.summary: Service level: workbench as implemented on 2026-09-13. Follow linked subjects for related levels.

nodes.name: Archboard system
nodes.description: Context above this service: the workbench is one logical subsystem of the Archboard canvas server.

nodes.name: Workbench subsystem
nodes.description: A logical subsystem inside the canvas server. It composes one private package-local Codex app-server session and publishes its state to browser panes.

nodes.name: Canvas composition
nodes.description: Builds the production workbench module inside the canvas server and owns startup, replacement, shutdown, and shared adapters.

nodes.name: Browser gateway
nodes.description: Leases browser connections, projects authoritative workbench state into bounded snapshots and deltas, and dispatches accepted browser commands.

nodes.name: Codex process
nodes.description: Prepares the isolated CODEX_HOME and SQLite paths, starts and stops the child process group, and reports lifecycle evidence.

nodes.name: Codex transport
nodes.description: Frames stdio requests, responses, notifications, and reverse requests with child-epoch correlation and bounded pending work.

nodes.name: Codex session
nodes.description: Initializes app-server, proves storage, gates account and thread operations, validates identities, and classifies mutation delivery outcomes.

nodes.name: Thread link
nodes.responsibility: Binds one pane to one workhorse
nodes.description: Discovers, creates, refreshes, and recovers the single workhorse thread linked to a semantic pane under current child ownership.

nodes.name: Workhorse queue
nodes.description: Owns queued work, reorder and start behavior, and the authoritative queue projection for the bound workhorse.

nodes.name: Coordinator
nodes.description: Owns the separate coordinator thread, its dynamic tools, callbacks, approvals, and semantic context without replacing the workhorse.

nodes.name: Codex app-server
nodes.description: External child process launched as `codex app-server`; it communicates only through the owned stdio transport and private storage.

nodes.name: Browser pane
nodes.description: The active semantic pane supplies one leased socket connection and consumes the projected session state.

beats.heading: Install a private generation
beats.body: Canvas composition prepares isolated storage and starts one external app-server child through the Codex process owner.

beats.heading: Establish the reviewed session
beats.body: Transport correlates stdio messages while Codex session initializes capabilities, proves storage, and opens account and thread gates.

beats.heading: Bind work and publish it
beats.body: Thread link, queue, and coordinator own their distinct workflows; the browser gateway turns their state into bounded messages for the leased pane.
